prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 83.9%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.8%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Pet Generation Waiting Screen Tips & Timer', 'Split View Path Choice Screen Redesign']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Interactive Pet Customization Stage', 'Defer Sign-In After Pet Selection', 'Desktop Controls Quick Reference Screen', 'Photo Upload Quality Guidance Flow', 'Explicit Account Pet Sync Copy', 'Desktop Pet Display & Launch Status Indicator', 'Fast Track Path Choice Guidance', 'First Launch Desktop Mascot Welcome Flow', 'Pre-Adoption Pet Trait Showcase Screen', 'Cloud Account Pet Preservation Copy', 'Waiting Screen Background Pet Animation Preview']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Interactive Desktop Controls Tutorial Screen', 'Pet Path Guided Selection Flow', 'Adoption Certificate Name Entry & Stamp', 'First-View Desktop Display Check', 'Account Persistence and Single Sign-In Redesign', 'Welcome Starter Gift Completion Incentive', 'Spotlight Path Selection Screen Redesign', 'Story Intro Reordering Sequence Flow', 'Compact Card Layout for Pet Generation Waiting Screen']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Adding tips and a timer to waiting screens was helpful (+8.9%, p=0.0008), matching predictions (+8.0%).
Redesigning path choice screens was helpful (+12.0%, p=0.0), far exceeding predictions (+1.0%).
Adding new screens (new_screen), new guidance flows (new_flow), or path hints (hint) showed no clear effect.
Changing copy (copy), reordering steps (reorder), or adding status indicators/animations showed no clear effect.
Predictions for copy changes, step reordering, hints, and new screens/flows were consistently too high, while predictions for path choice redesign were too low.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: Grid Layout Pet Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the friend selection screen into a full visual grid layout with larger preview cards so users can quickly inspect and choose starter pet models.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and long completion time (mean 1017s), with support receiving complaints about custom pet creation errors.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your New Pet Companion
pick_friend.body: Select your favorite pet from our instant starter collection.

candidates.title: Split View Generation Waiting Screen Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the waiting screen into a split-view layout featuring a live progress indicator and interactive tips side-by-side.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a massive mean time of 2336s. Redesigning key screens into split layouts previously delivered significant conversion improvements.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: Your pet is being customized and prepped for your desktop.

candidates.title: Post Setup Desktop Pet Launcher Flow
candidates.change: Add an explicit interactive pet spawn launcher button on the completion screen to help users immediately launch and locate their pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Finish step drops to 64.8% conversion (mean 5815s) and 3 support emails reported pets not showing up or app failing to launch after setup.

home_intro.headline: Launch Your Pet onto Your Desktop
home_intro.body: Click below to place your pet on your screen and open control settings.

candidates.title: Two Column Desktop Controls Summary Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home introduction screen into a two-column layout highlighting essential desktop pet shortcut keys and interaction options.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints from users who were unclear on how to hide, move, or talk to their pet after onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready!
home_intro.body: Learn how to interact, minimize, and talk to your new companion.

candidates.title: Background Pet Generation Notification Toggle
candidates.change: Add background desktop notification options on the waiting screen so users know they will be alerted as soon as pet creation completes.
candidates.why: Mean wait time during generation is 2336s, causing user anxiety or abandonment while waiting for the pet to build.

waiting.headline: Generating Your Pet in the Background

candidates.title: Starter Pet Accessory Bonus Selection
candidates.change: Display a free accessory reward badge during pet selection to motivate users to complete the adoption step.
candidates.why: Adoption stage is the biggest bottleneck in the onboarding funnel with only 60.9% conversion.

candidates.title: Cloud Pet Account Backup Clarification
candidates.change: Update sign-in screen headline and body copy to explicitly state that signing in saves and secures pet data across sessions.
candidates.why: Top support theme (8 emails) reported pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Pet to Your Cloud Account
sign_in.body: Signing in ensures your pets and custom items are safely backed up and never lost.
sign_in.hint: Use your primary email to keep your desktop pets synced across all devices.

candidates.title: Path Selection Duration Expectation Hint
candidates.change: Add a duration hint on the path choice screen clarifying that quick adoption takes less than 1 minute.
candidates.why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s; setting clear time expectations reduces user hesitation.

choose_path.hint: Quick Adoption takes under 1 minute. Custom pet creation takes ~3 minutes.

candidates.title: Pet Customization Progress Stage Counter
candidates.change: Enable step counters and progress text during generation to inform users about ongoing loading phases.
candidates.why: High average waiting time (2336s) leads users to think pet rendering has frozen or failed.

candidates.title: Compact Photo Upload Preview Layout
candidates.change: Switch the custom photo upload screen to a compact layout with dedicated photo preview pickers for better user input.
candidates.why: Support noted 3 issues where custom pet creation failed or resulted in distorted pet appearances.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photo
upload_photos.body: Provide a clear front-facing photo of your pet for best generation results.
